Rounded Corners Tool

Round the corners of any image with an adjustable radius — perfect for avatars, cards and app UI — and download the result as a transparent PNG.

Checkerboard in the preview means transparency.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your image.
  2. Drag the corner-radius slider to taste.
  3. Preview the rounded result instantly.
  4. Download it as a transparent PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Are the rounded corners transparent?

The corners are genuinely transparent, so the image blends over any background, dark or light.

Can I make a circular image?

Drag the radius all the way up and the image becomes a perfect circle (or oval for non-square images).

What images work best?

Square profile photos look best, but any image works.

Is my image uploaded?

No — everything is processed locally in your browser.
